summary: The Build minimal experiment establishes the intended ONE PIECE editorial workbench and preserves the deck-building flow, but it cannot pass while the required environment value is invisible, the same selector lacks keyboard parity, and the requested disabled publish state is absent.
passes: All three viewports render with zero document horizontal overflow.
Warm paper, compact navy header, single search, ruled rectangular filters/pool/tray/sheet, red publish and yellow selected states are visually coherent.
No pill controls, Hero, or unsupported decorative media were detected.
List/grid switches restore correctly with Enter and Space.
Filters expand/collapse with Enter and Space; type filtering changes 41 cards to 17 and resets to 41.
Search for 超梦 returns one matching card.
Card quantity can be reduced from 60/60 to 59/60 with Enter and restored to 60/60 with Space.
Invalid publish retains the sheet and exposes visible validation feedback.
Draft save changes only isolated local storage, closes the sheet, and exposes success feedback.
Publish sheet opens and closes; pointer opens the environment wheel.
Visible focus ring is present on primary publish controls.
Reduced-motion media query is active in every fresh context.
No external non-GET request was observed; all five other routes have zero horizontal overflow.
detail, mine, event and round fresh hashes match the frozen implementation proof; Plaza is fresh-captured and unedited.
